response.sql:
WITH regional AS (
    SELECT
        d.A3 AS region,
        AVG(CASE
                WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount
                WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount
            END) AS average_signed_amount,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE t.date >= '1996-05-09'
      AND t.date <= '1998-01-06'
    GROUP BY d.A3
), with_overall AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        average_signed_amount,
        transaction_count,
        AVG(average_signed_amount) OVER () AS overall_average
    FROM regional
)
SELECT
    region,
    average_signed_amount,
    transaction_count,
    average_signed_amount / overall_average AS ratio
FROM with_overall
WHERE overall_average IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: The text values in trans.date use a lexicographically sortable YYYY-MM-DD format, matching the supplied date bounds.
